notes: Django 3.2.25 LTS + DRF 3.12.4 on 3.9 -> Django 5.2.19 LTS + DRF 3.18.3 on 3.12. Settings follow the django toy: tests/conftest.py configures them in pytest_configure (no DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE, no database; the views are plain @api_view functions over an in-memory store). Unlike the django toy (2.2), on 3.2 ugettext_lazy/url/is_safe_url are warning wrappers, not aliases, so their entries are REMOVED with a successor, not MOVED. pytz is not in the manifest (as in many projects): Django 3.2 installed it, Django 4+/DRF 3.15+ do not, so `import pytz` breaks on the target with no API change in Django itself. USE_TZ: the conftest never sets it; Django 5.0 flipped the default to True, which changes every naive datetime the API renders. The equivalent migration pins USE_TZ=False (the documented way to keep 3.2 behaviour); the change scenario's break is independent of it. Old side warns RemovedInDjango40Warning (a DeprecationWarning subclass) for url (4 calls), ugettext_lazy, is_safe_url, and RemovedInDRF314Warning for NullBooleanField (all Python-level). force_text/ugettext are covered by the django toy and left out here. DRF 3.15 made serializer data plain dicts (ReturnDict no longer an OrderedDict; validated_data is a dict): equal values, different types; the tests only compare JSON. S3: importing app.views/app.serializers needs configured settings on both sides (DRF reads its settings at import of rest_framework.views).
